tasks.subject: Wire LibraryScreen to SyncService watchlist/history
tasks.description: Replace the hardcoded EmptyState in lib/features/library/library_screen.dart with a real list driven by SyncService (users/{uid}/watchHistory). Show loading, empty (with add-content CTA), and populated states. Reuse existing widgets (EmptyState, LoadingState, SectionHeader, MovieCard).

tasks.subject: Add AdminNavItem to AppShell bottom navigation
tasks.description: In lib/features/shell/app_shell.dart, conditionally render the AdminNavItem (from lib/features/admin/admin_nav_item.dart) in the NavigationBar destinations when auth.isAdmin is true. Switch to a custom bottom bar so the destinations list can be dynamic.

tasks.subject: Run analyze and tests, report blockers
tasks.description: Run flutter analyze across the whole project and flutter test, then report every error/warning with file and line. Do not fix code; only report.

tasks.subject: Architecture review of t1/t2 changes
tasks.description: Review the LibraryScreen and AppShell changes against the existing architecture: state management via Provider, content id format 'tmdb:type:id', navigation via AppRouter, and the sync/offline contract.
